programme.title: Island Crossings
programme.desc: A freight backlog in Stornoway has area operations manager Fiona struggling to keep supply lines open. Meanwhile, trainee sisters Tanya and Natalie go to sea. It's a big change for the two young women, who have never lived away from their island.

programme.title: Mhairi Black: Being Me Again
programme.desc: When 20-year-old Mhairi Black was elected to be the member of parliament for Paisley and Renfrewshire South in 2015, she became the youngest person since the act of parliament in 1832 to take a seat in the House of Commons. As if that wasn't enough, the man she pipped to the post was former foreign secretary Douglas Alexander. She won hands down, beating him by almost 6,000 votes, and all before she had even completed her politics degree at Glasgow University.

programme.title: River City
programme.desc: Roisin is at her wit's end when Gillian's behaviour reaches breaking point and Jodie drops a bombshell. Chris is forced to face the music when he realises paying Nicole is impossible, Tyler struggles to get dirt on Alex, and Amber considers her next steps with Angus.

programme.title: Mrs Brown's Boys
programme.desc: After accidentally picking up one of Cathy's novels, Agnes discovers she has a surprising fondness for steamy fiction. When she gatecrashes Cathy's book club meeting to share her insights, Cathy is mortified.

programme.title: The Tech Billionaire Takeover
programme.desc: A new breed of tech billionaires are building their own countries, replacing democracy as we know it and targeting the global financial system. Matt Shea goes inside their world.

programme.title: OnlyFans: Inside the Machine
programme.desc: Amber Haque reveals how OnlyFans models suffer widespread exploitation and coercion at the hands of their managers.

programme.title: Dating Apps: The Inside Story
programme.desc: Documentary exploring how our love lives have been transformed by the rise of dating apps beginning with Tinder's explosive launch in 2012. In just over a decade, digital romance has become big business: a global industry worth more than $8 billion, dominated by Match Group, the powerful conglomerate behind 45 platforms, including Tinder, Hinge and OkCupid. With annual revenues around $3.5 billion, Match has reshaped how millions meet, but at what cost?

programme.title: Shabaz Asks: Are Billionaires Bad?
programme.desc: Shabaz Ali, better known to his more than four million followers as @ShabazSays, became an internet sensation during the pandemic from his bedroom in Blackburn, building a huge audience with his hilarious takedowns of influencer culture, pointless luxury and people with more money than sense. From designer ice cubes to gold-plated nonsense, if it's a ridiculous display of wealth, chances are that Shabaz has had something scathing to say about it.

programme.title: Deadly 60
programme.sub-title: Making of Alaska and South America
programme.desc: Two of the toughest environments were the frozen tundra of Alaska and the steaming rainforests of Brazil. Steve and the team show how they coped with filming in temperatures below minus 20 and in the humidity and heat of the unforgiving jungle in order to film the incredible wildlife that call it home.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: The lads attempt to make train travel cheaper, faster and more interesting by replacing the conventional carriages and locomotive with a series of caravans attached to a specially modified car. Also in this show, Jeremy is out on the track comparing the ripsnorting Jaguar XKR-S to the recently updated Nissan GT-R, while British comedy legend Rowan Atkinson is the 'Star in the Reasonably Priced Car'.

programme.title: I Am Legend
programme.desc: A group of scientists engineers a cure for cancer. programme.title: Lewis and Clark: The Journey of the Corps of Discovery
programme.desc: This four-part documentary series by Ken Burns tells the story of the momentous journey that began in 1804 when Meriwether Lewis and William Clark headed up the Missouri River to explore America's unknown spaces. The series reflects their bond of friendship as well as their vision of the West as it was before the rest of the nation followed them and changed it forever. Extensive use is made of archive material and the stunning cinematography portrays the beauty of the land itself. Part 1 of 4.
